read.en: Zscaler fell 0.8% on Nov 16 to $190.84, trading $186.51–194.21. It is above the 100-day ($185.4) and 200-day ($166.5), and below the 5-day ($193.1), 10-day ($201.5) and 30-day ($221.1), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($222.09), and RSI is 34.9.
read.zh: Zscaler 11月16日下跌 0.8%，收于 $190.84，盘中区间 $186.51–194.21。股价位于 100 日（$185.4）和 200 日均线（$166.5）上方，位于 5 日（$193.1）、10 日（$201.5）和 30 日均线（$221.1）下方，三者均在下行。MACD 自 11月2日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$222.09），RSI 为 34.9。

read.en: No level changed: the $186.51 low dipped under the $187.5–188.9 band intraday but the close held above it, and the $194.21 high was capped near the 5-day. Resistance is $193.1–197.4, then $201.5–203.5 (10-day, Nov 9–11 highs) and $210.5. Support is $186.5–188.9, then $184.6–185.4 (Nov 12 low, 100-day) and $166.5 (200-day). A close above $197.4 would target $201.5–203.5; below $184.6, $166.5.
